escena: SCENE (the Efeonce studio, Santiago, one shared work table seen from straight above): a large table of dark charcoal matte linoleum with a fine grain fills the frame, mid-process. FOUR people work on it at once, each entering from a different edge of the frame — only hands and forearms in frame, sleeves of the Efeonce navy piqué and plain dark knits: from the top edge a hand slides a printed storyboard frame into a sequence of six photographic frames; from the left edge a hand marks a line on a thin current-generation aluminium tablet showing a dark media plan with coloured bars, illegible from this height; from the bottom edge two hands type on a slim aluminium unibody laptop with minimal bezels showing a dark dashboard with a single bright azure (#0375DB) line chart, illegible; from the right edge a hand holds a small fan of three paint-and-paper colour swatches over a printed key visual. All four pieces of work touch in the centre of the table around one shared printed brief sheet, so the four jobs visibly converge on one document. Hard late sunlight from a window out of frame on the left rakes across the table and draws long crisp shadows of the fingers and the swatches; the right third falls into deep, detailed shadow. Clean, cared-for, premium: no coffee rings, no clutter, no mug, no plants, no books, no old hardware. Current-generation devices only, no third-party logos. Printed matter is present but illegible by distance and angle. No faces, no heads.

lecho.objeto: the out-of-focus edge of a dark felt desk mat in the immediate foreground along the bottom of the frame
lecho.tono: DARK charcoal felt in deep shadow, matte, far outside the sunlight
